name: Werewolf Night
hook: Wolves hunt by night. The village votes by day.
how: Everyone gets a secret role: werewolf, seer or villager. At night the wolves pick a victim and the seer checks one player; by day the village talks it out and votes someone out, until every wolf is gone or the wolves match the village.
controls: Click or tap a player to act or vote, type to chat
uses: Your role is sealed so only you can read it (the host deals, so it can too).
The host's browser runs night and day, checks every move and counts the votes; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the village: they chat, accuse, claim to be the seer and vote. A bot wolf hunts too.
ideas: Add a doctor who can save one player each night
Let the werewolves chat in secret at night
Set it on a pirate ship with mutineers
